verdict.rationale: Windows exposes documented programmatic surfaces (Windows App SDK/WinUI 3 APIs, PowerShell scripting as an official CLI/automation interface) that a developer or AI agent could use to drive the system, but there is no evidence of a modern discoverable API contract (llms.txt, OpenAPI/Swagger spec) — probes for these on Microsoft's own domains returned 404s. missing for 10: a unified/discoverable public API spec (OpenAPI/llms.txt), explicit agentic/automation-oriented API documentation, and independent confirmation of AI-native usage of these APIs.
